title: US scientists lose clearances while Nazis are put in charge

tellings.quote: >> everybody that actually worked for us during the war lost their security clearances right so Oenheimer loses his security clearance Jack Parsons loses his right

plain: After the Second World War, the Americans who had worked for the country during the war lost their security clearances, meaning their permission to see secret material, while former Nazis were put in charge. A researcher named Peter Levenda says this without naming a source, and gives as examples the physicist J. Robert Oppenheimer and the rocket engineer Jack Parsons. In his telling, it would mean that the people who ended up running America's most secret work after the war had come from the other side.
